About Chestnut

Insurance explained properly, by people who work in it.

Chestnut Insurance Agency is a Nairobi-based insurance agency that helps individuals, businesses and organisations understand their risks, choose suitable cover and get support when they claim.

What we believe

Expertise

Insurance is technical and the wording matters. We explain cover, limits and exclusions in clear Kenyan context so you know what you are buying.

Advocacy

We are on the client’s side of the table: reading the wording, asking insurers the awkward questions and supporting you when a claim arises.

Practical solutions

Quotes, renewals, reviews and claims should be easy. We keep the process simple and the communication plain.

How we work

Chestnut is an intermediary. We advise you, gather the information insurers need and approach suitable insurers for terms. The policy is issued by the insurer and governed by its wording. You decide what to buy.

We focus on business and specialist insurance, including professional indemnity, WIBA, liability, property, engineering and marine, alongside personal covers for motor, medical, travel and home.

Chestnut Insurance Agency is an insurance agency licensed by the Insurance Regulatory Authority (IRA). Licence number IRA/05/44335/2026.
